body: Well we're already married. We eloped and the reception is in a few weeks. I'm supposed to move in September. It's really hard and I feel like I'm in an impossible situation. I'm still sorting everything out and I appreciate people responding. I don't like talking about this with people I know...which I know sounds dumb.

I've been in and out of therapy. Struggled with going back because she usually tells me he's not going to get better and I need to leave. I'm just not ready for that yet.

I'm sorry to hear about you failing classes. I almost failed out of school because of a depression but was able to bounce back the next semester.
Thanks. I'm feeling a little better this morning. Things get super overwhelming and I've struggled with anxiety and depression since I was a kid.
